hints.title: Only minSize Matters
hints.text: Any longer valid substring containing at most maxLetters distinct letters must also contain a sub-window of size minSize that is valid.

hints.title: Fixed Window Size
hints.text: Fix the sliding window size strictly to minSize. Counting frequencies of minSize substrings guarantees finding the maximum.

hints.title: Frequency Counter of Substrings
hints.text: Slide a window of length minSize across s. If unique character count <= maxLetters, increment substring frequency in a table.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substring sizes up to maxSize repeats work because smaller substrings occur at least as frequently.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting only length minSize windows dramatically shrinks search space and eliminates outer loops.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate deduces the mathematical property that minSize dominates any larger substring count.
complexity.notes: maxSize parameter is intentional distractor; inspecting only minSize is sufficient.
